algo: supervised imitation pretrain + REINFORCE (online, baseline EMA b=0.05, eps 0.30->0.08 live / greedy eval)
trained: pair-aware 20->32->4 swap scorer + linear 73->4 dir prior
features: raw color-equality counts of the cell AND its swap neighbor (no valid-move oracle) + 73 global sensory/LIF features

units.evalMode: eps=0.05 exploration during eval rollouts (matches train.py methodology)
units.eval120.*: avg total points per 25-move game over 120 fresh boards
units.eval120.random: uniform over ALL on-board swaps — no rule knowledge (naive baseline)
units.eval120.randomValid: uniform over VALID pairs — needs game-rule search (strong baseline)
units.eval120.firstFoundPlanner: always plays the first valid move found (search baseline)
units.oracle30: avg points per 25-move game over 30 boards, best valid pair each move
units.supervised.hit120: fraction of 120 boards where one greedy move forms a match
units.supervised.avgScore120: avg points of that single greedy move

honestNote: Reward = match score/200 (dopamine), invalid = -0.05. No oracle features; planner labels are used only as the supervised teaching signal, never as policy inputs.
negativeControl: Engineered valid-move planner beats the trained readout by search; the readout earns its label: every decision flows eye->LIF->readout.
